blocks.text: This page tracks the West Vancouver MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for October 2026: $2,299,200 for a typical home, down 3.5% over twelve months.
West Vancouver benchmark prices and trends, October 2026

A typical West Vancouver home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $2,299,200 in October 2026. That is up 2.4% on the month, little changed at +0.2% over three months, up 3.5% over six months and down 3.5% over the year. Over three years it is down 13.0%, and over five years down 14.3%.
The weakest one-year move in West Vancouver was for a detached home homes at −7.2%; the strongest was an apartment at +4.5%.
The board reports no townhouse benchmark for West Vancouver. The gap between a detached home ($2,864,900) and an apartment ($1,142,600) is $1,722,300.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,068,600, West Vancouver is 115.2% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.2% against down 3.5% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, West Vancouver ranks 1 by all-home benchmark, with Bowen Island below it at $1,395,700.

Detached homes in West Vancouver: benchmark $2,864,900, up 1.5% in a month, little changed at −1.1% in three months, little changed at −0.3% in six months, down 7.2% in a year, down 13.2% in three years and down 11.0% in five. That is 61.4% above the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,775,200).

Apartment homes in West Vancouver: benchmark $1,142,600, up 4.1% in a month, up 3.5% in three months, up 12.3% in six months, up 4.5% in a year, down 10.6% in three years and little changed at −0.7% in five. That is 69.7% above the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($673,400).

blocks.text: In dollars, the typical West Vancouver home is worth about $83,400 less than in October 2025, when the benchmark was near $2,382,600. By type, detached homes lost about $222,300, from $3,087,200 to $2,864,900, and apartments gained about $49,200, from $1,093,400 to $1,142,600 over those twelve months. Further back, the benchmark was near $2,221,400 six months ago and near $2,642,800 three years ago, so today's figure sits about $77,800 above the six-month mark and about $343,600 below the three-year mark. Against Greater Vancouver, the West Vancouver benchmark is about $1,230,600 above the regional $1,068,600; a year earlier the difference was about $1,255,400 above.
What the West Vancouver figure is
The $2,299,200 West Vancouver figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for October 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in West Vancouver?
faq.a: In October 2026, a typical West Vancouver home was $2,299,200, with detached at $2,864,900.

faq.q: Are West Vancouver home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: West Vancouver is down 3.5% over twelve months and little changed at +0.2% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
